| `complete` | On every host, the IPv6-only attribute of all IPv6 wildcard listeners is known. |
| `partial` | At least one host knows the IPv6-only attribute for only some IPv6 wildcard listeners. |
| `unavailable` | At least one host knows the IPv6-only attribute of none of its IPv6 wildcard listeners. |
| `unknown` | No host loaded, or a host reported an unrecognized status. |

network_inventory_status.description:
Aggregate network-inventory enrichment coverage across loaded hosts (worst per-host status wins).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `complete` | Every requested network namespace on every host was scanned successfully with no errors. |
| `partial` | At least one host failed to scan some namespaces, or scanning raised errors. |
| `unavailable` | At least one host failed to scan all of its namespaces. |
| `unknown` | No host loaded, or a host reported an unrecognized status. |

reasons.description: Machine-readable reason codes explaining any degraded or truncated state among loaded hosts.

truncated_hosts.description: Number of loaded host graphs that were truncated at collection time.

ServiceMapTopologyRequest.description: Query parameters for the outbound topology traversal.

anchor.description: Host (and optional entity) to start the traversal from.

at.description: Time selector for the query. Only `now` is currently supported; omitting the field behaves the same.

depth.description: Maximum traversal depth from the anchor. Default 1, maximum 3.

direction.description: Traversal direction. Only `outbound` is currently supported; omitting the field behaves the same.

include_metrics.description: Whether to include the raw per-edge `metrics` payload in the response. Default `false`.

max_edges.description: Maximum number of edges to examine before truncating. Default 200, maximum 1000.

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of nodes to return before truncating. Default 100, maximum 500.

network_scope_id.description: Optional integrity check: if set, must match the network scope already associated with `anchor.host_id`, or the request is rejected with `InvalidParameter`.

unresolved_mode.description: How unresolved edges are projected. `full` (default) includes them in `edges` and `unresolved_endpoints`; `summary` omits them from `edges` and returns only a bounded sample in `unresolved_endpoints`.

ServiceMapTopologyResponse.description: The outbound dependency graph discovered around the anchor host.

anchor_entity_id.description: Echo of the requested anchor entity ID, when one was given.

anchor_host_id.description: Echo of the requested anchor host ID.

coverage.description: Aggregate coverage and enrichment status across loaded hosts.

edges.description: Edges discovered during the traversal. Excludes unresolved edges when `unresolved_mode=summary`.

freshness.description: How recent the graph data is.

network_scope_id.description: Network scope the graph was resolved within.

observed_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds the underlying data was observed by the agent (the most recent among loaded hosts).

resolution_counts.description: Counts of edges by resolution outcome.

truncated.description: True if any bound (`max_nodes`, `max_edges`, or an internal query budget) cut the traversal short.

truncation_reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons the traversal was truncated, when `truncated=true`.

unresolved_endpoints.description: Sample or full set of edges whose destination could not be resolved, per `unresolved_projection`.

unresolved_projection.description: How unresolved edges were projected into this response.

ServiceMapUnresolvedEndpoint.description: An outbound edge whose destination endpoint could not be confidently resolved to a node.

edge_id.description: Edge ID, unique within its host.

host_id.description: Host the edge's source node lives on.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason the endpoint could not be resolved.

source_entity_id.description: Entity ID of the source node.

source_netns_id.description: Network namespace ID the connection originated from.

ServiceMapUnresolvedProjection.description: Summary of how unresolved edges were projected into the response, bounded by `unresolved_mode`.

by_reason.description: Breakdown of `total` unresolved edges by reason code.

mode.description: The `unresolved_mode` that was applied. `full` = unresolved destinations are listed completely in `unresolved_endpoints` and their edges stay in `edges` (default); `summary` = unresolved edges are excluded from `edges` and `unresolved_endpoints` keeps at most 20 samples, complemented by the `by_reason` counts.

omitted.description: Number of unresolved edges found but not returned (`total - returned`).

returned.description: Number of unresolved edges included in `unresolved_endpoints`.

total.description: Total number of unresolved edges found, regardless of how many were returned.

ServiceMapUnresolvedReasonCount.description: Count of unresolved edges sharing one reason.

count.description: Number of unresolved edges with this reason.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

SessionExportRequest.description: Export the full event transcript of one session as a streaming NDJSON body.

include_subagents.description: When true, each subagent_dispatch line is followed by the child session's full event stream, bracketed by its own session_meta. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

SessionGetRequest.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

limit.description: Page size for events; takes precedence over `num_recent_events`. 0 uses the server default (100).

num_recent_events.description: Legacy page size: number of most-recent events to return. Superseded by `limit` when both are set; 0 uses the server default (100).

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response; pass it back to fetch the next older page.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

share_token.description: Share token for accessing a session through its share link. Omit it for normal account-authorized access.

SessionGetResponse.description: A session plus a backward-paged window of its events.

has_more_older.description: True when older events remain beyond this page.

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass back as search_after_ctx to fetch the next older page. Omitted when has_more_older is false.

suggest_init.description: Account-wide onboarding flag: true when the account has zero knowledge packs in any scope; not specific to this session.

access_source.description:
How the caller received access to this session. Omitted when no access source is resolved. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `owner` | Caller is the session creator (full access) |
| `team_member` | Caller belongs to the session's bound team (full access) |
| `manager` | Manager grant (reserved; never produced by the current version) |
| `share_link` | Granted via a valid share link (view/fork only; cannot continue or manage) |
| `participant` | Same-account non-member granted via a participable team session (view/continue/fork only) |

app_name.description: Agent app that owns the session.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when archived; 0 means not archived.

can_continue.description: True when the caller can add a new turn to this session.

can_fork.description: True when the caller can fork this session.

can_manage.description: True when the caller may rename/archive/delete the session; personal sessions are creator-only, team sessions allow the creator, account admin, or team member.

can_view.description: True when the caller can view this session.

context_window.description: The bound model's max context size in tokens. 0 means unknown.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the session was created.

current_context_tokens.description: Size in tokens of the LLM context window as of the most recent turn. 0 means no turn has completed.

current_turn_active_ms.description: Active working duration in milliseconds for the current or most recent round, excluding time spent waiting on ask_user; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_started_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the current or most recent round started; 0 if no round has started yet.

current_turn_tokens.description: Total tokens (input+output+reasoning) for the in-flight round across the parent and its subagents; only computed by session/get while the session is running, always 0 in session/list responses and when idle.

current_turn_wait_ms.description: Accumulated ask_user human-wait duration in milliseconds for the current round; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

entry_kind.description:
Surface that created the session. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `web` | Created from the web console |
| `im` | Created from an IM client (IM bot / IM H5) |
| `api` | Created via the public API |
| `automation` | Created by an automation rule (unattended run) |
| `subagent` | Child session spawned by a parent's agent_dispatch (audit label; at runtime it executes on the web tool surface) |

has_unread.description: True when there is assistant output the caller has not yet viewed.

is_mine.description: True when the caller created this session.

is_running.description: True when an agent turn is currently in flight for this session.

last_event_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent assistant-side event.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id for subagent (child) sessions; empty otherwise.

pinned_at.description: Caller's per-user pin time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds; 0 means not pinned.

session_name.description: Session title; may be empty for untitled sessions.

share_enabled.description: True when the session's share link is active.

share_version.description: Revision of the share link; it increases when sharing is revoked.

shared_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when sharing was last enabled; 0 if never shared.

shared_by.description: Person ID that most recently enabled sharing; 0 if never shared.

state.description: Raw session-state bag (session-scoped keys). Omitted when empty.

status.description: Lifecycle status. One of: `enabled` (active), `deleted` (soft-deleted, no longer accessible).

team_id.description: Owning team id; 0 means no team is bound. Immutable after create.

team_name.description: Resolved team name; empty for unbound rows or deleted teams.

template_staging_round_id.description: Current save→validate round id (template-assistant only); empty otherwise.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last session update.

SessionListRequest.description: Filters for listing agent sessions. `all` visibility means the caller's own personal sessions plus accessible team sessions; account admins do not see other users' personal sessions.

app_name.description:
Agent app whose sessions to list. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ask-ai` | Ask AI assistant |
| `support` | Customer-support agent |
| `support-website` | Website support agent (exposed over A2A, not built into the console) |
| `support-flashcat` | Flashcat-site support agent (exposed over A2A) |
| `ai-sre` | The AI SRE main app |
| `template-assistant` | Notification-template assistant (template editing/validation) |
| `swe` | Internal benchmarking app (not customer-facing) |

asc.description: Ascending order when true, descending when false. Only honored together with `orderby`; when `orderby` is omitted the sort is always `updated_at` descending.

entry_kinds.description: Restrict to sessions produced by these surfaces; empty returns every kind.

include_subagent_sessions.description: Include subagent-dispatched sessions in the list.

orderby.description: Sort field: `created_at` by creation time, `updated_at` by last update; defaults to `updated_at` when omitted.

scope.description: Visibility scope: `all` (own personal + accessible team sessions), `personal`, or `team`; default `all`.

status.description: Archive bucket: active (default) returns un-archived, archived returns archived, all returns both.

team_ids.description: Optional explicit team filter; intersects with `scope` and never expands access.

suggest_init.description: Account-wide onboarding flag: true when the account has zero knowledge packs in any scope; not dependent on this call's filters.

total.description: Total number of sessions matching the filter (ignoring pagination).

SessionTokenUsage.description: Cumulative session-level token rollup across all turns. The account-billing source of truth.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens, including the cached portion.

SignedURLs.description: Short-lived signed URLs for downloading or previewing a file.

download_url.description: Relative URL (`/safari/artifact/stream?...`) that serves the file as an attachment. Prepend the API base `https://api.flashcat.cloud` before use; expires with `expires_in`.

expires_in.description: Validity of both URLs in seconds (300).

preview_url.description: Same as `download_url` but served inline for browser preview.

account_id.description: ID of the account the rule belongs to.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel the rule belongs to.

created_at.description: Creation time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

deleted_at.description: Deletion time, Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted unless the rule is soft-deleted; deleted rules are excluded from list responses.

filters.description: Alert event match conditions; matching events are silenced within the time window.

from_incident_id.description: Incident the rule is attached to. Always present; the zero ObjectID `000000000000000000000000` means the rule was not created from an incident.

is_auto_delete.description: When true, the silence rule is automatically deleted after its time window expires. Defaults to false.

is_directly_discard.description: When true, silenced alerts are dropped instead of suppressed into incidents.

is_effective.description: Whether the rule's time window covers the current moment, evaluated at response time.

status.description: Rule status: `enabled` or `disabled`; deleted rules never appear in the list.

time_filter.description: One-off silence window. Present with zero values when the rule uses recurring `time_filters` instead.

time_filters.description: Recurring silence windows. Empty when the rule uses a one-off `time_filter`.

updated_at.description: Last update time, Unix timestamp in seconds.

updated_by.description: ID of the user who last updated the rule.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.
Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

SkillItem.description: An AI SRE skill — a packaged SKILL.md bundle the agent can load.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit this skill.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the skill zip.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content. Omitted in list responses.

created.description: Set only on install-from-session responses: true = fresh install, false = in-place update.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the skill.

description.description: Human-readable description from the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description_en.description: Optional English description. English-locale UI responses prefer this over `description`; the skill catalog also uses it as a stable selection signal when `description` is localized for display.

is_modified.description: True when a marketplace-sourced skill was edited locally (auto-update skips it).

s3_key.description: Object-storage key of the skill zip.

skill_name.description: Skill name, unique within its scope (account-wide or within one team).

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template this skill was installed from; empty for user-authored.

status.description: Skill status. Deleted skills are excluded from every API response, so only these two values are ever returned.

tags.description: Tags parsed from the frontmatter.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = the owning team.

update_available.description: True when the marketplace has a newer template version.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

venues.description: Execution-environment kinds (EnvironmentKind strings, e.g. `byoc`) the skill is restricted to. Omitted when empty, which means the skill is available in all venues.

version.description: Skill version from the frontmatter.

SkillListRequest.description: Pagination, search, and team filter for listing skills.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (team_id=0) rows. Defaults to true. Ignored when `scope` is `account` or `team`.

query.description: Free-text search across skill name, description, English description, skill ID, marketplace source template name, and author.

scope.description: Restrict results to `all` (default), `account`-only (team_id=0), or `team`-only (excludes account-scoped rows). Overrides `include_account` when set.

team_ids.description: Filter to these team IDs; empty = the caller's visible set.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

description.description: New description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Sending an empty string leaves the current value unchanged — there is no way to clear it via this field.

description_en.description: New English description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to explicitly clear it.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team. Omit to leave unchanged.

SkillUploadRequest.description: Multipart form for uploading a skill archive.

file.description: Skill archive (.skill / .zip / .tar.gz / .tgz). Max 100MB; oversized files are rejected before the body is read.

replace.description: When true, overwrite an existing skill instead of failing on a name collision — matched by `skill_id` if provided, otherwise by skill name.

skill_id.description: Existing skill ID to target when replacing a specific skill (requires `replace=true`).

team_id.description: Team scope for the created/upserted skill: 0 = account-wide. Ignored when replacing a specific skill via `skill_id`.

SnoozeIncidentRequest.description: Parameters for snoozing notifications on one or more incidents.

incident_ids.description: Incident IDs to snooze. At most 100 per call.

minutes.description: Duration in minutes. Must be greater than 0 and at most 43,200 (30 days).

SourcemapBinaryImage.description: Loaded binary image from a crash report.

arch.description: CPU architecture for this binary image.

is_system.description: Whether this binary belongs to the operating system.

load_address.description: Runtime address. Accepts a hex string such as `0x100000000` or a decimal integer.

max_address.description: Runtime address. Accepts a hex string such as `0x100000000` or a decimal integer.

uuid.description: Build UUID identifying the binary or dSYM.

SourcemapCodeSnippet.description: One source-code line returned around an enriched frame.

code_snippets.description: Source-code snippets around this frame. Omitted when no snippet was extracted (for example the source content was unavailable or `near` was not requested).

converted.description: Whether the frame was successfully symbolicated or deobfuscated.

original_frame.description: The original minified/obfuscated frame before enrichment. Omitted when the processor did not retain one.

third_party.description: Whether the frame is from third-party or system libraries (Android and native symbolication only). Omitted when `false`.

created_at.description: Upload timestamp, Unix epoch seconds.

git_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA for this build.

git_repository_url.description: Git repository URL associated with this build.

key.description: Storage key uniquely identifying this sourcemap file.

metadata.description: Platform-specific metadata: `minified_url` (browser/react-native/harmony/miniprogram); `build_id`, `variant`, `version_code` (android mappings), plus `arch`, `lib_name`, `code_id` (android/harmony/electron native symbols); `uuid` (ios); `build_id`, `platform`, `arch`, `flavor`, `code_id`, `debug_id` (flutter); `subpackage`, `minified_url` (miniprogram). Omitted when empty.

minified_path.description: Deprecated. Storage path of the minified file; present only on JavaScript records.

minified_url.description: Deprecated. URL of the minified file; present only on JavaScript and miniprogram records. New integrations should read `metadata.minified_url`.

sourcemap_path.description: Deprecated. Storage path of the sourcemap file; present only on JavaScript and miniprogram records.

type.description:
Platform store this record belongs to. JavaScript rows always report `browser` (including HarmonyOS ArkTS and React Native uploads); native-symbol rows always report `android` (including HarmonyOS native and Electron uploads).

| Value | Store |
|---|---|
| `browser` | JavaScript sourcemap store |
| `android` | Android mapping store, or the shared native symbol store |
| `ios` | iOS dSYM store |
| `miniprogram` | WeChat mini program sourcemap store |
| `flutter` | Flutter Dart AOT symbol store |

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp, Unix epoch seconds.

version.description: Application version string.

build_id.description: Android only. Filter by Gradle plugin build identifier. Max 200 characters.

end_time.description: End of upload time range, Unix epoch milliseconds. Maximum window: 365 days.

kind.description: Symbol type filter, Android and HarmonyOS only (ignored for other platforms): `mapping` (default) lists ProGuard/R8 mappings or ArkTS sourcemaps, `native` lists native .so symbols.

orderby.description: Sort field; defaults to `created_at` descending when omitted.

query.description: Free-text substring match. Matches `minified_url` for the JS stores (browser/react-native/harmony/miniprogram), `build_id` for android/flutter/electron and harmony with `kind=native`, or `uuid` for ios (case-insensitive, hyphens ignored).

services.description: Filter by service names. Up to 100 values.

start_time.description: Start of upload time range, Unix epoch milliseconds. Must be > 0 and before `end_time`.

type.description:
Platform whose symbol store to list. Defaults to `browser` when omitted; any other value returns an empty list.

| Value | Store listed |
|---|---|
| `browser` | JavaScript sourcemaps (shared store; excludes HarmonyOS ArkTS and React Native rows) |
| `android` | ProGuard/R8 mapping files; with `kind=native`, Android NDK .so symbols |
| `ios` | iOS dSYM symbol files |
| `miniprogram` | WeChat mini program sourcemaps |
| `react-native` | React Native JS sourcemaps |
| `harmony` | HarmonyOS ArkTS sourcemaps; with `kind=native`, HarmonyOS .so symbols |
| `flutter` | Flutter Dart AOT symbols |
| `electron` | Electron Breakpad symbols |

uuid.description: iOS only. Filter by dSYM bundle UUID. Max 200 characters.

versions.description: Filter by version strings. Up to 100 values.

items.description: Sourcemap records of the current page. Omitted when empty.

total.description: Total number of matching records. Omitted when 0.

arch.description: Android NDK architecture such as `arm`, `arm64`, `x86`, or `x64`.

binary_images.description: Loaded binary images from an iOS crash report.

build_id.description: Android build ID for Gradle plugin 1.13.0 and later.

near.description: Number of nearby meaningful source lines to return around converted frames.

no_cache.description: Skip cached enrich results. Intended for debugging.

platform.description: Narrows a `react-native` enrich to the app's native platform: `ios` for the iOS native layer, `android` for the Android native layer (the console derives it from the event's OS). Ignored for other `type` values.

service.description: Application or service name used when the sourcemap was uploaded.

source_type.description: Android error source type. Use `ndk` with `arch` for native symbolication.

stack.description: Raw stack trace to parse and enrich.

type.description:
Source platform whose symbol store is used. Defaults to `browser` when omitted.

| Value | Symbolication |
|---|---|
| `browser` | JavaScript stacks via sourcemaps |
| `android` | Java/Kotlin stacks via ProGuard/R8 mappings; native stacks via NDK symbols (send `source_type=ndk` with `arch`) |
| `ios` | iOS crash stacks via dSYM (send `binary_images`) |
| `miniprogram` | WeChat mini program stacks via sourcemaps |
| `harmony` | HarmonyOS stacks via ArkTS sourcemaps or native symbols |
| `flutter` | Flutter/Dart stacks via Dart AOT symbols |
| `electron` | Electron JavaScript stacks via sourcemaps; minidump native frames via Breakpad symbols (derived from `source_type`) |
| `react-native` | React Native JS stacks via sourcemaps; narrow the lookup with `platform` |

variant.description: Android build variant used by older Gradle plugin versions.

version.description: Application version used when the sourcemap was uploaded.

frames.description: Error stack frames after symbolication (via sourcemap, dSYM, NDK symbol tables, etc.).

SourcemapStackFrame.description: Parsed stack frame fields shared across platforms.

column.description: Column number for JavaScript or Flutter frames.

file.description: Source file, URL, or module path.

method_name.description: Android Java/Kotlin method name without class prefix.

StatusPageChangeCreateResponse.description: Result of creating a status page event.

StatusPageChangeItem.description: A status page event (incident or maintenance).

affected_components.description: Components currently affected by this event, with their resulting status. Omitted when no components are affected.

auto_update_by_schedule.description: Maintenance only: whether the status advances automatically based on the scheduled window. Omitted when false.

close_at_seconds.description: Event close time in Unix seconds. For maintenances this is the scheduled end time; for closed events, the time the event reached its terminal status (`resolved`/`completed`). Omitted when not set.

is_retrospective.description: Whether this event is a retrospective (historical) one. Omitted when false.

linked_change_ids.description: Linked event IDs (related incidents, deployments, etc.). Omitted when empty.

notify_subscribers.description: Whether subscribers were notified about this event. Omitted when false.

page_id.description: Parent status page ID. Omitted when 0 (never for stored events).

responder_ids.description: Member IDs responsible for this event. Omitted when no responders are assigned.

start_at_seconds.description: Event start time in Unix seconds, derived from the first timeline update. Omitted when 0.

status.description: Current event status. Incident statuses: `investigating`/`identified`/`monitoring`/`resolved`. Maintenance statuses: `scheduled`/`ongoing`/`completed`. Omitted when empty (never for stored events).

type.description: Change type. `incident` is an unplanned outage; `maintenance` is a planned maintenance. The type determines which status values are valid.

updates.description: Timeline updates attached to this event, ordered by time. Omitted when the event has no timeline updates.

items.description: Status page changes (incidents/maintenances) matching the filters.

StatusPageChangeTimelineCreateResponse.description: Result of appending a timeline update to a status page event.

StatusPageChangeUpdateItem.description: A single timeline update on a status page event.

component_changes.description: Component status transitions applied by this update. Omitted when the update changes no component statuses.

status.description:
Change status after this update. Omitted when the update does not change the overall status. The first four values apply to incident-type changes, the last three to maintenance-type changes.
| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `investigating` | Investigating (incident). |
| `identified` | Root cause identified (incident). |
| `monitoring` | Fix deployed, monitoring (incident). |
| `resolved` | Resolved (incident). |
| `scheduled` | Scheduled (maintenance). |
| `ongoing` | In progress (maintenance). |
| `completed` | Completed (maintenance). |

StatusPageComponentChangeItem.description: Component status transition applied in a timeline update.

component_name.description: Component display name. Populated by the backend on read; ignored on write. Omitted when empty.

status.description: New component status. Incidents support `operational`/`degraded`/`partial_outage`/`full_outage`; maintenances support `operational`/`under_maintenance`.

available_since_seconds.description: Time the component became available, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Omitted when 0.

hide_all.description: When true, the component is hidden entirely from summary endpoints. Omitted when false.

hide_uptime.description: When true, uptime data is hidden from summary responses. Omitted when false.

order_id.description: Display order within its section. Omitted when 0.

section_id.description: Parent section ID. Omitted when the component sits at the top level.

StatusPageDraftCreateResponse.description: Result of storing a status page draft.

created_at.description: Creation time in Unix epoch seconds.

draft_id.description: Draft ID matching `draft_[A-Za-z0-9]{22}`; the console review link carries it.

managed_domain_feature_enabled.description: Whether the managed custom-domain feature is enabled for this page. `true` for public pages, always `false` for internal pages.

StatusPageInfoResponse.description: Status page detail returned by `GET /status-page/info`: the full page configuration plus feature flags.

components.description: Components tracked on the status page.

contact_info.description: Get-in-touch contact, a mailto or website URL. Omitted when not set.

custom_domain.description: Custom domain pointing to the status page. Omitted when not set.

custom_links.description: Custom navigation links shown on the status page. Omitted when not set.

dark_logo.description: Dark-mode logo image of the status page. Omitted when not set.

date_view.description: How the timeline displays change dates. `calendar` uses a calendar view; `list` uses a list view. Omitted when not set.

display_uptime_mode.description: How uptime is displayed. `chart_and_percentage` shows both the uptime chart and the percentage figure; `chart` shows only the chart; `none` hides uptime entirely. Omitted when not set.

favicon.description: Favicon of the status page. Omitted when not set.

logo.description: Logo image of the status page. Omitted when not set.

logo_url.description: URL opened when the logo is clicked. Omitted when not set.

name.description: Display name of the status page.

page_footer.description: Footer content of the status page. Omitted when not set.

page_header.description: Header content of the status page. Omitted when not set.

template_preference.description: Preferred event template type: `pre_defined` or `message`. Omitted when never set.

type.description: Page visibility type. `public` pages are accessible to anyone and use email subscriptions; `internal` pages are restricted to account members and use IM subscriptions.

TargetInventoryServiceMapCapability.description: ServiceMap capability and live status of a target's host.

authoritative.description: True if the current status derives from an authoritative graph snapshot.

capability_status.description: Agent-reported capability status, e.g. `running`, `disabled`, `starting`, `failed`, `unsupported`. Omitted when the agent has not reported one.

capture_mode.description: Capture mode, e.g. `ebpf` or `polling`. Omitted when unknown.

edge_count.description: Number of edges in the host's current graph.

enabled.description: Whether ServiceMap collection is enabled on the agent.

error_code.description: Set to `status_unavailable` when the live status could not be read; other fields then fall back to inventory-derived values. Omitted otherwise.

freshness_status.description: Freshness classification of the host's graph. `fresh` = the latest snapshot was received within 2x the report interval; `stale` = no new snapshot within that window; `unknown` = not yet classified. Omitted when unknown.

graph_available.description: True if a current graph can be fetched for this host right now.

max_age_ms.description: Maximum snapshot age in milliseconds tolerated before it counts as stale. Omitted when not applicable.

node_count.description: Number of nodes in the host's current graph.

observed_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the agent last observed graph generation. Omitted when unknown.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable codes explaining the current capability status. Omitted when empty.

received_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the server last received a snapshot. Omitted when unknown.

report_interval_ms.description: Configured reporting interval in milliseconds. Omitted when unknown.

snapshot_ready.description: True if the agent has produced at least one full snapshot.

status.description:
ServiceMap collection status of the host.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `active` | Collection healthy: a fresh snapshot exists with no degradation. |
| `degraded` | Collecting but quality is impaired: health reports are newer than the snapshot, the snapshot is truncated/degraded, or collection is failing. |
| `stale` | A snapshot exists but is outdated (no update within 2x the report interval). |
| `initializing` | The agent reported the capability but the first snapshot is not ready yet. |
| `disabled` | Topology collection is disabled on this host. |
| `unsupported` | The agent or kernel does not support collection. |
| `no_data` | No snapshot or health data received yet. |

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Absent / empty means this is the last page.

servicemap_coverage.description: ServiceMap status-fetch coverage for this page. Omitted when no item on the page carries ServiceMap data.

## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **Audit Read** (`organization`) |

## Usage

- Time range is required. Maximum span is 90 days. Both `start_time` and `end_time` are Unix epoch **seconds**.
- Use `search_after_ctx` from the previous response to fetch the next page. The token is opaque — do not construct it manually.
- The retention window depends on the account's license. Queries beyond the retention boundary silently return an empty result rather than an error.
- `limit` accepts 0–99; omitting it (or 0) returns all matching rows in the window with no page-size cap. Rows are returned newest first.

## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **100 requests/minute**; **5 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Any valid `app_key` (read-only; not gated by a specific permission class) |
| Edge requirement | Supported deployments require **monit-edge v0.65.0 or later** |

## Usage

- Treat **monit-edge v0.65.0** as the minimum supported Edge version for this public API. WebAPI retains migration adapters for older Edge versions: query.v2 results may still preserve frames, records, or samples, while legacy rows can expose only the information they retained. These adapters do not change the support floor; older protocols lack query.v3 cancellation and error-lifecycle semantics, and data already lost by legacy rows cannot be recovered.
- The public response format is always `query_result.v1` and is independent of the internal Edge query protocol. Dispatch on `result.kind` (`frames`, `records`, or `samples`); do not infer the result shape from `ds_type` or the Edge version.
- A `frames` result may contain multiple table or time-series frames. Field values are columnar and all fields in one frame have the same length.
- A `records` result may contain nested JSON and null records. Integer literals outside JavaScript's safe integer range are returned as decimal strings.
- A `samples` result contains label sets and instant values. A value may be a number or one of the strings `NaN`, `+Inf`, and `-Inf`.
- The final success response is limited to 8 MiB and query results are limited to 1,000 rows. Narrow the time range, reduce fields, or aggregate at the source when a request exceeds a limit.
- Query failures use non-2xx HTTP status codes and the standard error envelope. Do not transparently fall back to the deprecated `/monit/query/rows` endpoint.
- Query execution may take up to 35 seconds across WebAPI forwarding and Edge execution. Configure client timeouts to at least 40 seconds and propagate cancellation when the caller abandons a query.

## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **600 requests/minute**; **10 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Any valid `app_key` (read-only; not gated by a specific permission class) |

## Usage

- This is a diagnostic / RCA endpoint, not a raw data query — pair it with `/monit/query/data` when you need the underlying data.
- Only three `ds_type` and `operation` pairs are supported: `loki` / `victorialogs` → `log_patterns`, and `prometheus` → `metric_trends`. Every other datasource is rejected, even when `operation` is explicit.
- `methods` selects the analyses to run; when omitted, `log_patterns` defaults to `pattern_snapshot + pattern_compare(previous_window)` and `metric_trends` defaults to `single_window_shape + window_compare(previous_window)`.
- `time_range` is in Unix seconds; missing or invalid values default to the last 15 minutes; a window wider than 6 hours is rejected.
- The request is forwarded over WebSocket to `monit-edge`. Long-running: the request may take up to ~30 s on the edge side plus webapi overhead. Set client timeouts to **at least 35 s**.
- `options.*` are upper-bounded by edge (`max_logs_scanned` ≤ 50 000, `max_patterns` ≤ 50, `examples_per_pattern` ≤ 3, `step_seconds` ∈ [15, 300], `max_series` ≤ 200, `topk` ≤ 50, `timeout_seconds` ≤ 30).
- The success body is a raw `{"data": ...}` object WITHOUT the usual `request_id` wrapper field (raw passthrough from the edge).
- Two error layers: request-level failures return a non-200 status with the standard `error` envelope, while edge-level execution errors come back as HTTP 200 with an `error` object in the body — check both.
- Log examples are basic-redacted before being returned; expect `warnings: ["examples redacted"]`. Do not treat them as raw logs.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **600 requests/minute**; **10 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | Any valid `app_key` (read-only; not gated by a specific permission class) |

## Usage

- Up to **8** tools per call (`MaxToolsPerInvoke`); larger batches must be split client-side. The 8-tool cap aligns with the per-target agent concurrency.
- Tools execute in parallel on the agent; webapi returns `results[]` aligned with the request `tools[]` order.
- Long-running: set client timeouts to **at least 35 s**. The endpoint is intended for AI-SRE / human-RCA flows, not interactive UI.
- Request-level errors (`target_unavailable`, `ambiguous_target_kind`, `forward_failed`) appear as HTTP 200 with `data.error` set and `data.results = []`.
- Per-tool failures appear as HTTP 200 with `data.error` absent and `results[i].error` populated — always check **all three** layers (outer envelope `error`, `data.error`, then each `results[i].error`).
- The response uses **sparse fields**: absent means empty. On success `error` is omitted entirely rather than sent as `null`; on failure `data`, `summary` and `truncated` are omitted. Do not key logic off placeholder `null` fields, and do not expect `target` when the locator could not be uniquely resolved.
- `results[i].data` is the tool payload with the monit-agent result envelope **already unwrapped** — there is no nested `data.data`. The one-line distillation is `results[i].summary`, and `results[i].truncated` (carrying a `reason`) appears only when the result was genuinely truncated.
- `results[i].params` echoes the params webapi received for that tool, so batched calls stay correlatable even when an individual tool fails.
- Construct `tools[].params` against the `input_schema` returned by `/monit/tools/catalog`. For no-arg tools always pass `params: {}` explicitly.
